金蛇郎君夏雪宜.en: Osiris, ruler of the underworld, has a lesson for Horus. Isis is keeping an eye on them both.
金蛇郎君夏雪宜.zh-CN: 冥界之主奥西里斯准备给荷鲁斯上一课。伊西斯正留意着他们父子俩。

金蛇郎君夏雪宜。.en: Osiris has a lesson for Horus, with Isis watching.
金蛇郎君夏雪宜。.zh-CN: 奥西里斯准备指导荷鲁斯，伊西斯在旁看着。

text.en: Osiris! Even the underworld lets you take a day off?
text.zh-CN: 奥西里斯！原来冥界也肯给你放一天假？

text.en: A very short one. Horus, let's see what you've learned.
text.zh-CN: 很短的一天。荷鲁斯，让我看看你学到了什么。

text.en: Try teaching our son without flattening him, dear.
text.zh-CN: 亲爱的，教儿子就好，别把他打扁了。

text.en: Isis, I said a lesson, not a funeral. Ready, Horus?
text.zh-CN: 伊西斯，我说的是上课，又不是办葬礼。荷鲁斯，准备好了？

text.en: Not bad, Horus. Next time, let your feet catch up with your enthusiasm.
text.zh-CN: 不错，荷鲁斯。下回先让脚步跟上你的热情。

text.en: Then come with us for a while. The world could use a little family supervision.
text.zh-CN: 那就陪我们走一阵吧。这个世界也该让咱们一家照看照看了。

text.en: I have an underworld to run. It doesn't exactly manage itself.
text.zh-CN: 我还得管着冥界。那地方可不会自己运转。

text.en: Then help us follow your treasure map. A short trip, a few directions, hardly any paperwork.
text.zh-CN: 那就帮我们看看你留下的藏宝图吧。走一小段，指几次路，几乎不用批公文。

text.en: Those treasures were meant for us, remember? Our son inherited your sense of direction. Let's not test it.
text.zh-CN: 那些宝物本来就是留给我们的，记得吗？儿子把你的方向感也继承了。咱们还是别考验它了。

text.en: Fair enough. I'll come along and show you where I put it.
text.zh-CN: 好吧。我和你们一起去，指给你们看藏在哪儿。
